boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study settings in and around McQuade Library, ranging from silent stacks to reservable presentation space.

cards.title: Settle into the Foyse Family Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing that benefits from a silent setting, then use the second-floor directory to locate the dedicated quiet room.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent room for focused individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library lists the Foyse Family Quiet Study Room on its second floor and identifies it as a silent space for studying alone.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; the library’s posted Summer 2026 hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and access is for Merrimack students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Read among the lower-level stacks
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, lower level
cards.notes: Choose this silent-stack setting for uninterrupted reading; use the lower-level collection location as a natural break between study blocks.
cards.short_summary: A silent individual-study setting beside the H–Z collection.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library identifies its lower-level stacks as a silent space for studying alone and lists books H–Z on that level.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; the library’s posted Summer 2026 hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and access is for Merrimack students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Work beside the second-floor stacks
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use the second-floor stacks when you want a quieter solo setting with the A–H collection nearby for quick reference checks.
cards.short_summary: A quieter individual-study area on the library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library classifies its second-floor stacks as a quieter area for studying alone and lists books A–H on the second floor.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; the library’s posted Summer 2026 hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and access is for Merrimack students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Take a quieter second-floor table
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, second floor
cards.notes: Set up at a second-floor table for focused coursework, keeping it as a quieter alternative to the library’s livelier shared zones.
cards.short_summary: Quieter tables for individual or low-key study.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library identifies its second-floor tables as a quieter place to study.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; the library’s posted Summer 2026 hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and access is for Merrimack students, faculty and staff.

cards.entity_name: McQuade Library Third-Floor Group Study Tables
cards.title: Meet at the third-floor group study tables
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, third floor
cards.notes: Bring a small project group to the third-floor tables, then pair work time with support from the nearby tutoring or writing centers.
cards.short_summary: Group tables on the academic-support floor of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library lists group study tables on the third floor and identifies that floor as both quieter and suitable for group or individual study.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; the library’s posted Summer 2026 hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and access is for Merrimack students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Plan a collaborative session in Crowe Family Commons
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use this first-floor commons as a starting point for collaborative coursework, then consult the library help desk when research questions surface.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor commons inside McQuade Library.
cards.evidence_claim: McQuade Library’s building directory lists Crowe Family Commons and group study tables on the first floor, which the library identifies as a lively group-study area.
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library; the library’s posted Summer 2026 hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m., and access is for Merrimack students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Use the McQuade Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, second floor
cards.notes: Choose the computer lab when your assignment needs a campus workstation, and plan your session around the library’s posted operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor campus computer lab for eligible users.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack’s IT Services states that the Computer Lab is on McQuade Library’s second floor, is for Merrimack faculty, staff and students, and follows library hours.
cards.access_notes: Eligible to Merrimack faculty, staff and students; availability follows McQuade Library hours. Posted Summer 2026 library hours are Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Work one-to-one in McQuade 346
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, room 346
cards.notes: Use this quieter room for individual work or a scheduled writing consultation; confirm your appointment through the applicable academic-support service.
cards.short_summary: Individual workspace and one-to-one consultation space.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes Room 346 as a quieter room with one-on-one tutoring spaces and individual workspace, where most writing consultations occur.
cards.source_title: A Network of Academic Support, Tutoring, Study Partners near Greater Boston | Merrimack College
cards.access_notes: Part of the Writing, Tutoring & Math Center Suite in McQuade 346–348; one-on-one sessions are scheduled through the relevant academic-support service.

cards.title: Build a project in McQuade 348
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, room 348
cards.notes: Use the low tables and comfortable chairs for a group of four to six, especially when you also need programming computers or reference books.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative workspace with a computing zone and study resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack describes Room 348 as having low tables, comfortable chairs, collaborative space for groups of four to six, computers, textbooks and reference books.
cards.source_title: A Network of Academic Support, Tutoring, Study Partners near Greater Boston | Merrimack College
cards.access_notes: Part of the Writing, Tutoring & Math Center Suite in McQuade 346–348; the Tutoring & Math Center operates as drop-in support during its posted semester hours.

cards.title: Rehearse in The Fishbowl
cards.subtitle: McQuade Library, room 352
cards.notes: Reserve this conference room for a presentation run-through, mock interview, or group review that benefits from the full-size monitor and AirPlay.
cards.short_summary: A reservable presentation-practice room with a full-size monitor.
cards.evidence_claim: Merrimack identifies The Fishbowl as Room 352, a conference room with a full-size television monitor and Apple AirPlay for presentations and interviews; one-hour reservations are available through TutorAIRS.
cards.source_title: A Network of Academic Support, Tutoring, Study Partners near Greater Boston | Merrimack College
cards.access_notes: Located in McQuade Library Room 352; one-hour reservations are made through TutorAIRS.
